name: Gumloop
tagline: A no-code builder for AI agents and automations that connect your apps and AI models.
about: Gumloop lets teams build AI agents and workflows by connecting blocks. It works with the major AI models and many business apps.
pros: Connects to many apps and the major AI models.
Teams can share and reuse what they build.
cons: No free plan; paid plans start after a 14-day trial.
